Prototype · layer 1 of the adapter-showcase walk · 2026-08-29

In this shared plane, the seed decides where a trajectory lives; the prompt pair only nudges it

Each thread is one full 50-step denoising run under PoE composition: 8 held-out animal pairs × 8 seeds, drawn in the single best 2D plane shared by all 3,200 step-points. The eight pairs sharing a seed leave exactly one point (their common starting noise) and end, 50 steps later, a mean of 7.3 plane-units apart. Different seeds start 172 units apart. Hover any point to see that run; the card shows what the joint prompt, plain PoE, and PoE + adapter each rendered from it.

What this picture may claim: this plane holds 24.2% of the total variance (ten axes hold 87.3%; one trajectory alone fits its own plane to 99.5%). Distances between trajectories here are suggestive, not measurements. The pair differences may live in the 75.8% this plane cannot show.

Method, caveats, provenance

Object embedded: the PoE run's noisy latent x_t at each of 50 DDIM steps (SDXL VAE latent, 4×128×128 flattened to 65,536 numbers), for 64 held-out cells. Shared PCA: all 3,200 step-points pooled, mean-centred, fp32; the plot is the top-2 plane. Sampler: DDIM, 50 steps, guidance 7.5, fp16 run upcast for analysis.

  • Variance in this plane 24.2%, top-10 87.3%, computed from the eigenvalues of the pooled Gram matrix. A single trajectory's own top-2 plane holds 99.5% (cat × dog, seed 9), so per-cell planes and this shared plane answer different questions.
  • Same-seed starts coincide by construction (one seed, one initial noise, shared across pairs); their exact overlap here is a correctness check, not a finding. The finding is the end-of-run spread: 7.3 units within a seed vs 172 between seeds, in this plane.
  • The three renders per cell are final images: mono.png (joint prompt, the ceiling), poe.png (plain PoE), and the pooled LoRA adapter's render (checkpoint step 100,000, λ=1). Per-step decoded frames are not built yet; hovering steps moves the highlight, not the image.
  • t-SNE/UMAP were deliberately not used: distances in those embeddings are not distances. PCA is linear, so what this plane shows is at least honestly incomplete rather than distorted.
  • Cache: /datasets/mmolefe/poe_repair_min/outputs/training_cache/heldout/<pair>/seed_<s>/residuals/step_*.pt. Adapter renders: artifacts/results/does-the-fix-reach-unseen-pairs/pooled_lora/phase1_r8_100k/samples/per_epoch/epoch_2000_step_100000/.
